messages.subject: Project Falcon - legal DD question list
messages.plaintextBody:
James, Elena,

Following our review of the data room, please find our first legal due diligence question list below (also uploaded to the deal site). Priority items: the third-party SLAM library licence terms, the status of the two pending patent applications, the change-of-control clause in the grocery retailer contract, and confirmation of the EMI option scheme position.

Responses by 15 April would be ideal.

Deepa Kovac
Birchall Stone LLP
